successful_patterns.pattern: Turnover/attention level and its transforms (level, spike-vs-baseline, CV) are the strongest, most robust axis on full-A
successful_patterns.evidence: R1: turn_low IS ic 0.0895/ICIR 0.59 -> OOS 0.0797; turn_spike, turn_cv also accepted with 3/3 universes, 7/7 years; ivol was even subsumed by turn_low (corr>=0.7). But 3 accepted factors already sit near the 0.7 corr ceiling -> family is close to saturated.

successful_patterns.pattern: Tail/lottery measures (TsMax of returns, negative skew) beat plain volatility — vol factors collapse into them at dedup
successful_patterns.evidence: R1: max_eff IS 0.0832/ICIR 0.74, OOS 0.0909 (stronger OOS than IS); skew accepted; lowvol and amp_low both rejected as duplicates of max_eff. Prefer tail shape over dispersion.

successful_patterns.pattern: Price-volume agreement correlations (fade volume-confirmed rallies) give the highest ICIR signals
successful_patterns.evidence: R1: pv_corr ICIR 0.97 (best of round), OOS 0.0387; ts-rank variant and smart_flow (TsCorr(TURN,RET)) also accepted. Interaction of price and volume >> either alone.

successful_patterns.pattern: Decompose close-to-close returns into intraday and overnight legs: intraday leg carries the reversal, overnight leg is MOMENTUM (sign flip vs intuition)
successful_patterns.evidence: R1: intraday_rev subsumed rev20; overnight gaps positively predict. R2: leg idea kept paying — gap_vol (overnight-leg vol, alpha_0015) IS 0.070 -> OOS 0.085 (stronger OOS), overnight_mom60 accepted (0.042/0.035). But do NOT leg-decompose MAX: max_intraday hit corr 0.90 vs whole-return max_eff.

successful_patterns.pattern: Within-industry earnings yield (EP) is the one value signal that clears the bar
successful_patterns.evidence: R1: ep_ind IS 0.0410/ICIR 0.34, OOS 0.0176 (weakest accept, decays ~57%) but 3/3 universes and 7/7 years. Value works but thin at 10d horizon.

successful_patterns.pattern: Demeaned-rank interaction terms ((CsRank(A)-0.5)*(CsRank(B)-0.5)) mine conditional structure with near-zero correlation to both parents
successful_patterns.evidence: R2: rev_x_lowturn (alpha_0018) ICIR -0.65 IS / -0.90 OOS, max corr vs set only 0.17; max_x_spike (alpha_0019) ICIR -0.83 IS. Note the SIGN: both came out negative — names where the two bullish signals AGREE underperform; disagreement (hedged/mixed profiles) outperforms. Template is productive; try other parent pairs.

successful_patterns.pattern: Up/down semivol asymmetry is the one orthogonal vol construct
successful_patterns.evidence: R2: alpha_0016 accepted (IS 0.062/0.58, OOS 0.067/0.74, PFS 0.98) while vol_of_vol and max_intraday died at the corr gate. Downside-dominated vol earns, upside-dominated vol fades.

successful_patterns.pattern: Attention DURATION (days since turnover peak) adds liquidity info orthogonal to turnover level
successful_patterns.evidence: R2: turn_dur (alpha_0017) accepted with max set-corr only 0.47 despite 3 turnover factors already in the set; IS 0.041/0.60, OOS 0.032.

successful_patterns.pattern: Cash-flow yield (CFP) joins EP as the second value survivor and holds OOS better
successful_patterns.evidence: R2: cfp_ind (alpha_0020) IS 0.033 -> OOS 0.030 vs ep_ind's 0.041 -> 0.018. Cash-based value decays less than earnings-based.

successful_patterns.pattern: Volume-price interaction family keeps producing (3 rounds running); turnover ELASTICITY to |return| is the best construct yet
successful_patterns.evidence: R3: volresp_beta (-RegBeta(TURN_F, Abs(RET), 20), alpha_0024) IS 0.065/ICIR 0.83 (best of round), OOS 0.046/0.60, max set-corr 0.58. Volume response to moves, not volume level, isolates speculation-proneness.

successful_patterns.pattern: Self-relative (time-series) framing dodges the saturated cross-sectional turnover family
successful_patterns.evidence: R3: turn_selfrank (-TsRank(TURN_F,120), alpha_0022) IS 0.051 -> OOS 0.052, squeaked the corr gate at 0.69 vs the level factor. TS-rank reframing is a general trick, but the turnover axis is now truly full (5 factors) — stop proposing it.
R3: max_freq (-TsCount(RET > 2*TsStd(RET,60), 60), alpha_0021) IS 0.047 -> OOS 0.046, corr vs max_eff only 0.49.

successful_patterns.pattern: Frequency bands are separable: weekly-band decayed intraday reversal is distinct from the monthly sum
successful_patterns.evidence: R3: rev5_decay (-DecayLinear(CLOSE/OPEN-1, 7), alpha_0023) IS 0.041 -> OOS 0.052 (OOS stronger), corr vs alpha_0011 only 0.48, near-zero 10d rank-AC (fast factor).

forbidden_patterns.evidence: R1: rev_path (-TsSum(Sign(RET),20)) ICIR 0.21 < 0.30, rejected S1. Magnitude information matters.
R1: bp_ind ICIR 0.24, rejected S1 (EP passed instead). Stale book values don't cross-sectionally discriminate at short horizons.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Plain volatility/amplitude/idio-vol variants as standalone candidates
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R1: lowvol/amp_low/ivol died at dedup vs max_eff/turn_low. R2: vol_of_vol also died (corr 0.72 vs max_eff). The only vol construct that survived is the up/down SEMIVOL ASYMMETRY (alpha_0016, IS 0.062 -> OOS 0.067) — vol ideas must change the shape, not the scale.
R1: rev20 and rev20_ind died at dedup vs intraday_rev. The intraday leg is the purer carrier; don't re-propose whole-return reversal.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Over-saturating one family in a single round
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R1: 3 turnover factors + 3 volume-price factors accepted, several pairs near the 0.7 corr ceiling; marginal diversity per slot fell (set diversity 0.90). Cap ~2 candidates per family per round; the prompt explicitly lists over-saturation as a forbidden pattern.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Classic slow risk premia (beta, size shape, Amihud illiquidity) at the 10d horizon
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R2: low_beta ICIR 0.08, size_nl -0.26, amihud ICIR 0.18 (IC 0.027 but unstable) — all S1 rejects. These axes need the 20d+ label or portfolio-level treatment, not 10d cross-sections.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Price-path shape descriptors (trend residual, R-squared trendiness, return autocorrelation, close position in range)
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R2: resi_trend 0.08, rsq_choppy -0.08, ret_autocorr -0.09, close_pos 0.12 ICIR — the whole path-shape family is dead at 10d on full-A.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Higher tail moments beyond MAX/skew (kurtosis) and TTM earnings momentum via PctChange
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R2: kurt ICIR -0.12 (max_eff+skew already span the tail); sue_ttm IC 0.018/cov 0.86 — TTM-delta earnings momentum too weak/slow; needs announcement-dated surprise, not rolling TTM drift.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Treating the demeaned-rank interaction template as universal
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R3: gapvol_x_turn passed S1-S3 but FAILED stage 4 with 1/3 sub-universes (full-A-only effect = small-cap artifact); semivol_x_cfp died at S1 (value parents don't interact). The template only worked for behavioral-flow parent pairs (R2). Require both parents behavioral AND check sub-universe robustness expectation before spending a slot.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Earnings momentum at the 10d horizon in ANY form (rolling TTM or announcement-dated revisions)
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R2: sue_ttm failed S1. R3: earn_rev60 passed IS (0.022/0.34) but stage-4 showed OOS 2022-23 collapse to -0.003 with year_rate 0.57 — regime-dead post-2021, first true OOS kill of the pipeline. Fundamentals only survive as LEVELS (EP/CFP yields), not changes.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Composing two winning transforms and assuming the composition wins (gap x asymmetry), turnover distribution shape (skew), accruals and nominal price at 10d
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R3: gap_asym ICIR -0.04 (asymmetry does not transfer to the overnight leg); turn_skew 0.01; accruals 0.20; price_nominal 0.07; exp_growth 0.21 (express coverage 0.70 is usable but the signal is weak). leg_vol_ratio -0.31 also sub-gate.
